n_home.text:
Home and shift — behaviour

• Mode comes only from GET /v1/riders/me/dashboard `mode`. The control never flips until PUT /v1/riders/me/availability answers.
• Go online sends a real position fix. 422 CANNOT_GO_ONLINE lists details.blocking_reasons[]; each gets its own row and fix (see the 9-reason card).
• 403: ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE / ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE / PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_INCOMPLETE use the same rows.
• 409 ACTIVE_DELIVERY_IN_PROGRESS → offer go_offline_after_delivery: true (contract field on RiderAvailabilityInput).
• ONLINE_IDLE is a working state, not an empty state.
• 'Online since' is not shown: the dashboard does not return `since`. Today's figures are today.gross_cents / trips / online_seconds as returned.
• Banners are persistent (Proposed component: InlineAlert), never toasts. None is red.
• Server-forced offline arrives as rider.availability_changed, which carries no reason: the current-contract screen is OfflineNoReason ('HalalGoes set you offline', Go online shows any 422 blocking_reasons). OfflineCap and OfflineDocExpired follow dashboard.blocking_reasons. OfflineUnresponsive is the Needs API alternative.
• 'Online' means shift status only; the network is always 'internet connection'.
• Low battery (client-side): 'Power saving: tracking less often' uses the same banner.
• Sound/haptics: availability change confirmed = single haptic; queued = light warning haptic.
• Going online / offline: the control never flips while PUT availability is in flight; network or 5xx failures are drawn apart from 422 blockers (HomeOnlineFailed, HomeGoingOffline, HomeOfflineFailed).
• Offers reach a locked phone (full-screen intent / time-sensitive push), so the copy says the phone can be locked.
• Icon gap: wallet (Solar). The Earnings tab uses 'orders' as a labelled stand-in.
• Design system re-synced (Sep 28) to the design system's own tokens.css (1790605103-3266); no local overrides. Secondary text on rider screens uses text-secondary-field; plain text-secondary stays only on mono annotation tags.
• Map pins (owner decision): the map-pin tokens, a lighter step with a light outline in dark mode. tokens.css has no dark-mode pin values yet, so the boards draw the light fills with a text-primary outline.
• Theme follows the phone (owner decision): every rider board has a light and a dark theme (Tweaks: theme); the light boards are the light theme, not only a sunlight test.
• Payouts paused by Stripe after setup (owner decision): offers keep coming and earnings accrue, paid on the next Monday payout once Stripe is fixed; a slate banner lists Stripe's requirements as plain labels (HomePayoutsPaused; Needs API: plain-language labels for Stripe requirements, because the contract says they are shown verbatim). Under today's contract, going offline and back online would be blocked by PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_INCOMPLETE (Needs API: split it from a later restriction; tagged on HomePayoutsPaused and HomeBlocked).
• Suspended or deactivated while on a delivery (owner decision): finish it, unless HalalGoes contacts you (operations may move it to another rider), and get paid for it and for everything earned; only new offers stop. A turned-down replacement document doesn't stop offers while the current one is still valid (owner decision).
• Navigation: three tabs, Home, Earnings (with a Deliveries view) and Account (owner decision).

n_offer.text:
Offer — sound, haptics, focus

• Arrives: repeating OFFER sound that plays in silent mode and Do Not Disturb + long repeating haptic. Never sound alone: the full-screen layer is the visual signal.
• 25% left: single tick. 10% left: double tick + tone.
• Accept confirmed: single haptic. Taken / withdrawn / expired: neutral tone + double pulse.
• Focus lands on the sheet heading, which reads the whole offer once. Accept never gets initial focus. Focus trapped; Back and Escape ignored before expires_at. Countdown announces at 50/25/10/0%.
• DS Sheet variant=full, dismissible=false (its focus trap, title and Back / Escape handling); the main action sits in the Sheet footer. Dark surface = surface-chrome until a surface-offer role exists (proposed design-system role). BottomNav hidden.
• Arrival paths: push, dispatch.offer, GET /offers/current on foreground, socket connect and push receipt. Duplicates dropped by offer_id; an offer already past expires_at renders nothing.
• Countdown = expires_at − server_time; the ring total is that remaining time at the first render, never a local 30 s constant. Needs API: offered_at (or window_seconds) on DispatchOffer and dispatch.offer.
• Offer chrome: Proposed variant: Sheet tone=field (surface-chrome in dark); until it is approved the boards draw the library Sheet variant=full with its own surface, no local overrides; no ramp steps in any board; every label and body line is text-primary. Earnings: Proposed variant: Price size display-lg.
• Busy-time extra and tip are hidden when absent or 0; never $0.00 (sc-if showTip, see OfferTipHidden).
• Distance from the rider to the pickup is Needs API (DispatchOffer.pickup_distance_m); the map shows the rider's own position and the pickup as pins; before the rider accepts, the drop-off is only an approximate area (about 300 m, no centre point), never an exact pin. distance_m / est_duration_s labels are provisional until the contract defines them.
• Offline during the countdown: persistent banner, Accept stays (OfferConnectionLost). Push arrived but the offer failed to load: OfferLoadFailed, no amounts from the push. The lock screen and heads-up are generic ('New delivery offer · Open to see it'): the contract defines no push payload (Needs API, OfferLockScreen).
• A new offer replaces an Expired / Taken / Withdrawn result at once (OfferReplacesResult). Opened from the lock screen after expires_at → OfferLockScreenLate.
• Accept sends Idempotency-Key; a retry reuses the same key.
• Decline: one tap on a reason declines, no confirm step. Five frequent reasons first; the other seven behind 'More reasons'. 'Keep the offer' (72, critical) stays pinned beside the countdown; the decline sheet has no close X. No typed 'Something else' under the timer: OfferDeclineOther is a Needs API alternative (note optional for OTHER; an expiry during an open decline must not count toward UNRESPONSIVE). Reason rows are DS Button critical (72). 409 OFFER_EXPIRED on decline is silent.
• Tip before accept (owner decision): the offer shows the tip so far whenever it is above 0, as the contract returns it. The no-tip-before-accept alternative is gone.
• Accept label (owner decision): orange button with the dark label (text.onBrand on action.primary, 4.63:1). The rider 7:1 rule covers body text, not large bold button labels.
• Order of the offer: total → distance / time / items → pickup and drop-off area → breakdown. Drop-off is an approximate area only, the neighbourhood (owner decision: approximate area before accepting, full address once accepted): 'You get the full address when you accept.' Needs API: an approximate area on DispatchOffer (it sends the street and an exact point today). Offer accepted shows the full address.
• Breakdown rows render only when their field is present (tip also hidden at 0). Never $0.00 for a null, never derived from the total.
• Expired, taken and withdrawn stay on screen until 'Back to waiting' or the next offer: no auto-close (WCAG 2.2.1). Focus moves to the h1; the heading is announced once.
• 409 OFFER_EXPIRED on accept (the tap raced the expiry) is its own screen. Whether it counts toward UNRESPONSIVE is Needs API; the copy makes no promise.

n_owner.text:
Open owner decisions and contract asks (this canvas)

• Settled Sep 28 and applied: no tamper seals at launch (every seal screen removed; back in v1.1); tip shown before accept; the rider theme follows the phone; Accept keeps the orange button with the dark label; a Stripe payout pause never stops offers; a suspended rider finishes the current delivery, unless HalalGoes contacts them (operations may move it to another rider), and is paid; leave it at the door with a photo and a statement when the customer chose that; reversed earnings keep the original line plus a clawback line; dark-mode map pins; three tabs.
• Undelivered food policy: Returned makes no promise of pay until decided.
• Rider incident reporting (restaurant closed, 25-min not ready, breakdown, unwell, accident): LAUNCH BLOCKER. Under the current contract the only exit before pickup is ops reassigning.
• Needs API: distance to pickup on DispatchOffer; food disposition after cancel / reassign; notification permission on the heartbeat; OTHER note optional on decline; PAYOUT_ACCOUNT_INCOMPLETE split from a later Stripe restriction; proof-of-delivery accepting PHOTO_WITH_ATTESTATION when PHOTO is required.
• Design system: tokens.css has no dark-mode map-pin values yet; the Button critical label (Accept) renders at 18px semibold, below the 18.66px bold large-text size the Accept ruling relies on.
• Settled Oct 1 and applied: approximate drop-off area before accepting, full address once accepted; payouts paused by Stripe keep a rider working only if their payouts worked before (a rider who never finished Stripe setup can't go online).
